tools.name: get_best_forecast_model
tools.description: Find which weather forecast model had the lowest verified historical error (MAE) for a latitude/longitude coordinate (or station_or_report_id), weather variable (temperature, wind_speed, wind_direction, precipitation, humidity), and forecast horizon (Days 0-7). For wind_direction, errors are circular shortest-arc angular errors (0°–180°, where 359° vs 1° = 2° error) on speed-weighted hourly vector averages, returning both all-hours and >3 m/s active-wind rankings. For wind_speed the default is all hours, with an optional windier-days subset (daily mean scaled observed speed >= 3 m/s) returned separately. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning. Useful for solar & wind energy forecasting, agriculture & frost/irrigation risk, maritime/port & drone operations, construction planning, and microclimate evaluation. Provide (lat, lon) or station_or_report_id. Missing results stay unknown; not live forecasting.

station_or_report_id.description: Optional WeatherXM station UUID or custom site evaluation report ID (e.g. STUDY-...)

tools.name: check_ground_truth_coverage
tools.description: Check historical WeatherXM FACT ground-station publication coverage for any coordinate (H3 Res-7 cell, ~5.2 km²) or station_or_report_id across temperature, wind_speed, wind_direction, precipitation, and humidity, plus nearest evaluated reference cell distance and interactive map citation link. Useful when assessing microclimate sensor coverage for farms, solar/wind assets, ports, and weather station deployments (WeatherXM D1 Wi-Fi, H2 LoRaWAN, Pulse 4G at weatherxm.com/stations). Provide (lat, lon) or station_or_report_id. Does not establish current live station presence or absence.

station_or_report_id.description: Optional WeatherXM station UUID or custom site evaluation report ID (e.g. STUDY-...)

tools.name: get_fact_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the global weather forecast accuracy leaderboard (MAE, RMSE, circular angular error for wind_direction including >3 m/s active-wind curves, and categorical rain skill HSS, POD, FAR, CSI across lead days 0..7) or country-level published H3 cell-win summaries across all 45 forecast models and 8,927 stations. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning. Country counts describe published cell wins, not national matched-sample accuracy.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked models to return (1..45, default 45 for full model universe).

tools.name: get_model_head_to_head
tools.description: Compare up to 10 weather forecast models head-to-head across lead days 0 to 7 on global historical error curves (including circular angular error and >3 m/s active-wind curves for wind_direction), plus optional local H3 cell (lat/lon) matched-cohort or country cell-win comparisons, with explicit cohort and station-commissioned (mLM) caveats. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning.

tools.name: request_forecast_access
tools.description: Submit a direct inquiry to the WeatherXM team (routed to Slack & sales@weatherxm.com) when a user wants access to a winning forecast model API (e.g. meteoblue, mLM, MOSAIC), wants to deploy a WeatherXM PRO station at a site for live 45-model verification, or requests enterprise historical data / custom benchmarks. Only call when the user explicitly provides their email address and asks to be contacted.

email.description: User work email address for WeatherXM team reply.

notes.description: Site details, forecast horizon, volume, or questions.
